body:
## Issue

The 2026-08-05 user ruling bans em dashes (U+2014) in landlord-facing copy — enforced by `scripts/lint_em_dash.py` in CI. But **16 spec-verbatim copy owners are exempted from the ban, and every one of them is public-facing** (reference panel, referee-facing surfaces, landlord toast/timeline). 2026-08-14 clarification from the user: **no em dashes in ANY prose exposed to the public** — the exemptions must go.

The lint is currently green (123 files) purely because `SPEC_VERBATIM_OWNERS` lists these 16 names; the exemption mechanism is the loophole that lets em dashes ship to landlords.

## Inventory (all public, all carry U+2014)

`client/src/copy.gleam` (reference panel + toast):

| Owner | Current string | Suggested dash-free rewrite |
|---|---|---|
| `refcheck_subline_in_flight` (§10.3) | "We invite, remind, and nudge — you watch it happen." | "We invite, remind, and nudge. You watch it happen." |
| `refcheck_explainer_body` (§7.8) | "…your own judgement — the final call is always yours." | "…your own judgement. The final call is always yours." |
| `refcheck_state_unreachable` (§7.4) | "Invitation, 2 reminders, and an applicant nudge over 6 days — no reply." | "Invitation, 2 reminders, and an applicant nudge over 6 days. No reply." |
| `refcheck_state_refused` (§7.4) | "People decline for all sorts of reasons — this tells you nothing about {first_name}." | "People decline for all sorts of reasons. This tells you nothing about {first_name}." |
| `refcheck_state_failed` (§7.4) | "The check hit a problem on our side — not {first_name}'s." | "The check hit a problem on our side. It's not {first_name}'s fault." |
| `refcheck_confidence_line` (§10.3) | "Confidence: {level} · AI-generated summary — verify before relying on it." | "Confidence: {level} · AI-generated summary. Verify before relying on it." |
| `refcheck_signal_fast_completion` (§7.5) | "…Can happen when someone's prepared — or when answers were ready-made." | "…Can happen when someone's prepared, or when answers were ready-made." |
| `refcheck_signal_same_device` (§7.5) | "Innocent when they're together — but a referee's answers should be their own." | "Innocent when they're together, but a referee's answers should be their own." |
| `refcheck_signal_geo_mismatch` (§7.5) | "People move and travel — treat as a prompt to verify, not a verdict." | "People move and travel. Treat it as a prompt to verify, not a verdict." |
| `refcheck_signal_voip` (§7.5) | "Plenty of legitimate users — but it's also how a temporary number looks." | "Plenty of legitimate users, but it's also how a temporary number looks." |
| `refcheck_signal_duplicate_of_applicant` (§7.5) | "Usually a copy-paste slip — confirm directly with the applicant." | "Usually a copy-paste slip. Confirm directly with the applicant." |
| `refcheck_signal_reused_across_applications` (§7.5) | "Rare innocently — worth a careful look." | "Rare innocently. Worth a careful look." |
| `refcheck_toast_exported` (§7.6 OQ-5) | "Attempt log copied — paste it into your records or a message." | "Attempt log copied. Paste it into your records or a message." |
| `refcheck_timeline_terminal` (§7.6) | "unreachable" arm: "Closed — no reply" | "Closed. No reply." |

`server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam` (landlord-facing detail payload):

| Owner | Current string | Suggested rewrite |
|---|---|---|
| `written_response_disclaimer` (§9.5) | "Written response, provenance-checked — not verbally confirmed. A quick call to the referee is the strongest final check." | "Written response, provenance-checked. Not verbally confirmed. A quick call to the referee is the strongest final check." |

Suggested rewrites are drafts — final wording follows the brand voice in `_bmad-output/story-2026-04-03.md` (calm confidence, contractions, outcomes).

## Fix

1. Reword the 16 strings above (dash-free) in `client/src/copy.gleam` + `application_detail_handler.gleam`.
2. Remove all 16 names from `SPEC_VERBATIM_OWNERS` in `scripts/lint_em_dash.py` (or restrict the exemption mechanism to genuinely internal strings — there are none left public).
3. Copy-const tests (`client/test/copy_test.gleam`, `server/test/reference_checks/form_copy_test.gleam`) will need their pinned expectations updated if they assert these strings verbatim.
4. Sweep the other public surfaces for em dashes outside the lint's file scope (notification email templates — pinned by const tests today).

## Repro

Open any reference-check panel row (in-flight or terminal): header subline "We invite, remind, and nudge — you watch it happen." (em dash), fraud-signal lines on a completed check, the export toast, and the "Closed — no reply" timeline arm all carry U+2014.

## Acceptance

- [ ] No U+2014 remains in any public-facing string in the repo (grep + lint clean with the exemptions removed)
- [ ] Copy tests updated and green
- [ ] Rewrites preserve meaning + brand voice
title: refcheck copy: 16 spec-verbatim em-dash exemptions all ship em dashes to landlords — extend no-em-dash ban to all public prose
